brief:
**Goldstein Gooners (ESPN), week 4.** You're **0-3, last place**, and 8th of 10 in total points (306.5). Six of 10 teams make the playoffs, **seeded by record** (total points only break ties), over a 13-week regular season. With 10 games left, you realistically need to win about 7 of them, so every week counts.

**This week:** vs **Vivek's Handshakes** (2-1). ESPN projects **119.2 to 119.0**, a **50%** coin flip.

### Good moves already made
You've already picked up **Ollie Gordon II** (Achane is out for the season) and **Braelon Allen** (Breece Hall is week to week), plus **Kenyon Sadiq**. Those were the top waiver adds this week (NFL.com).

### Your players
- **Amon-Ra St. Brown (WR, DET) at CAR, Sunday night.** Your top projection (20.1).
- **Bucky Irving (RB, TB) and Cam Skattebo (RB, NYG):** both projected 16+.
- **Trevor Lawrence (QB, JAX) at CIN.** Cincinnati allows the 3rd-most passing yards (ESPN). Good matchup.
- **Kenyon Sadiq (TE, NYJ) is questionable:** limited in Wednesday practice with an undisclosed issue; he had offseason hernia surgery (RotoWire, ESPN). He went 7-105-1 last week.
- **Dallas Goedert (TE, PHI) is out for several weeks** with an MCL sprain (DraftKings Network). Safe to drop.
- **Jacory Croskey-Merritt (RB, WSH)** should lead Washington's backfield with Rachaad White hurt, though the team is adding Austin Ekeler for passing downs (Heavy).
- **Your Patriots D/ST plays at Buffalo:** projected just 3.1. Replace it (see Waivers).

### Your opponent (Vivek's Handshakes)
- **Jayden Daniels** is questionable with a dislocated elbow (RotoWire), so they start **Kyler Murray** (19.3 proj).
- **Jaylen Waddle** was seen in a walking boot but is reportedly fine (RotoWire).
- Core: Christian McCaffrey, George Kittle, Chris Olave, Kyren Williams.

- **Sunday ~3:50pm:** St. Brown inactives (Sunday night game).

### Hold

- **Jacory Croskey-Merritt:** Washington's lead back while Rachaad White is hurt.
trades:
### Where you stand (updated Fri Oct 2)
**0-3, last place.** Playoffs: 6 of 10 teams, **seeded by record** (total points only break ties). The trade deadline is **Wed Dec 2**, but every week you wait is a game you play short-handed.

**Done:** Pickens for Jaylen Warren went through ✅. Warren is now your best RB (17.0 projected).

### What the roster looks like now
- **RB surplus (6 healthy for 2–3 spots):** Warren, Irving, Skattebo, Braelon Allen, Ollie Gordon II, Croskey-Merritt.
- **TE surplus (3 for 1 spot):** Juwan Johnson, Kenyon Sadiq, Tucker Kraft.
- **WR is the hole:** St. Brown, Nabers, then Marvin Harrison Jr. (6.4 projected). Since Pickens left, one injury puts MHJ in your lineup.

### Do these now

| # | Partner | You give | You get | Why it works for you | Why they'd accept | Confidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Jake's Scary Team** (2-1) | Bucky Irving + Malik Nabers + Ollie Gordon II | **Garrett Wilson + Justin Jefferson** | Two WR1s for a WR2 and spare RBs. Keep Allen as RB cover. | They start Javonte Williams and Tuten with **no RB on the bench**, and have 7 WRs. Jefferson missed Wed–Thu practice (ankle), so they may sell him cheap. | Medium |
| 2 | **The Strib Club** (1-2) | Braelon Allen + Tucker Kraft | **Parker Washington** (WR, JAX) | A real WR3 (15.3 projected) instead of MHJ. | Their RBs: Barkley, Price (Q), Charbonnet (IR), Dobbins, Corum. Loveland (8.7) is a weak TE, so Kraft helps them too. If they say no, ask for Jameson Williams. | Medium |

**Lineup if both land (healthy):** Lawrence; Warren, Skattebo; St. Brown, G. Wilson; FLEX Jefferson; Juwan Johnson. Core skill spots project **~88** vs **~83** today. If Jefferson sits, Washington fills the FLEX (~85).
**Bench:** Washington, Croskey-Merritt, Sadiq, MHJ, Mason (IR), plus a free spot from the 3-for-2. Use it on **Jakobi Meyers** (WR, 74% owned, available) for depth.

### If #1 gets turned down
- **Fallback with Jake's:** Ollie Gordon II + Croskey-Merritt for **Michael Wilson** (13.3 proj, 25.9 last week) or **Jordan Addison**. Same logic: they need any RB.
- **Then chase a TE with Irving:** with Irving still on the roster, offer **Skattebo + Sadiq for Brock Bowers** to **Ts pmo** (only Taylor and Henry at RB, Etienne on IR; Mayer can replace Bowers). About +5–7 a week at TE. *Don't do this if #1 lands*, because it would leave you with only Warren and Croskey-Merritt at RB.
- **McBride is off the table if Nabers goes to Jake's.** If #1 fails, Nabers + Kraft for Trey McBride (Ben Doverbish) is still alive, but don't use Kraft twice. Pick that or #2.

### Don't
- **Don't trade St. Brown or Warren.** They're your floor.
- **Don't feed ranel** (2-1, holding a playoff spot) a WR upgrade.
- **Don't trade Juwan Johnson.** Keep him as the TE starter; Sadiq is the backup.
